title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Surcharge Carried by an Account That Ran Behind
content:
## Credit control table

A surcharge is carried into the price of a further term of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record by an account that ran behind in the term just ending. Two readings decide it: whether coverage stood withdrawn in the term, and how many payments have been received on the agreement.

| Coverage in the term just ending | Payments received on the agreement | Surcharge carried |
|---|---|---|
| stood withdrawn | fewer than 6 | the full arrears surcharge, 480.00 USD |
| stood withdrawn | 6 or more | the part arrears surcharge, 220.00 USD |
| never stood withdrawn | any | no surcharge |

### Notes

- Coverage stood withdrawn in the term where the day coverage was suspended falls on or after the first day of the term.
- At exactly 6 payments received the account is in the second row, carrying 220.00 USD; at 5 payments it carries 480.00 USD.
- Where coverage never stood withdrawn in the term, no surcharge is carried however few payments were received.
